notes.title: Demo Update 0.84
notes.content:
Hi everyone, we've made a few significant updates to the demo.

The upgrade screen has now been converted to a shop. You use gems collected from defeating enemies to spend at the shop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493388/e2762a441abcef61ca3c7142ac66b122eb71b8e2.png[/img]

We also added a golden star that appears randomly during runs. We wanted to create another way for players to farm gems instead of only earning them through combat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493388/0fda0744ab3fba385d17cb7636332e2e2ced3520.png[/img]

List of fixes:
[list]
[*] Patched glitch causing 'Quick Draw Blast' card to make rootkit move before getting hit by blaster
[*] Added a delay when choosing cards so players don't accidentally add/upgrade/remove a card right when the screen pops up
[*] Buffed the 'Add 1 of 6 cards' screen
[*] Added rebinding option
[*] Changed spyware enemy to only move when you play an attack card
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update 0.82
notes.content:
Hi everyone, we've made a few updates to the demo after receiving helpful feedback. 

If you have any suggestions or issues, please don't hesitate to reach out! 
[b]
List of Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Added new enemies (spyware, jumper, rootkit)
[*] Increased the amount of enemies that spawn in earlier waves 
[*] Added card dragging function
[*] Added the ability to cancel cards that require discarding and drawing
[*] Updated music in game
[*] Added the ability to save game progress and return to an existing run
[/list]

*Small Update on May 9th*
[list]
[*] Added a new item enemies can drop
[*] The jumper can now attack while moving towards you.
[/list]

notes.title: Hex Blast | Announcement
notes.content:
Hi Everyone, 

We are excited to announce our newest game, Hex Blast!

Hex Blast is a turn-based roguelike deckbuilder where you use hex-based cards to blast waves of cyber invaders on a dynamic grid.

Think of Slay the Spire meets Vampire Survivors!

[previewyoutube=1P1oFGnWSvo;full][/previewyoutube]

Playtesting will be begin on Steam soon, but the alpha demo is available now on itch.io

https://soy-boy-games.itch.io/hex-blast


If you have any feedback or suggestions, we would love to hear from you in [url=https://discord.gg/mHHQfjVSGj]our Discord[/url]!

- Soy Boy Devs
